hypotheses.statement: Average total amount per yellow taxi trip on Monday 2025-01-20 was higher than the average of the other three Mondays in January 2025 (2025-01-06, 2025-01-13, 2025-01-27).
hypotheses.support_if: avg_total_amount on 2025-01-20 > mean(avg_total_amount on 2025-01-06, 2025-01-13, 2025-01-27) by a meaningful margin (e.g., >5%).
hypotheses.refute_if: avg_total_amount on 2025-01-20 is within normal variance of the other three Mondays (e.g., <5% difference).

hypotheses.statement: Monday 2025-01-20 was Martin Luther King Jr. Day (federal holiday), which altered demand composition (e.g., more leisure/airport trips, fewer commuter trips) and raised average fare.
hypotheses.support_if: us_holidays shows a federal holiday on 2025-01-20 (MLK Day) and no federal holiday on the other three Mondays; trip count on 2025-01-20 differs significantly from baseline Mondays.
hypotheses.refute_if: 2025-01-20 is not a federal holiday, or trip count and fare patterns are similar to baseline Mondays.

hypotheses.statement: Adverse weather on 2025-01-20 (e.g., snow, low temperature, precipitation) increased fares via longer trips, surge-like conditions, or shift to taxi from other modes.
hypotheses.support_if: nyc_weather_daily shows snow_mm > 0 or prcp_mm > 5 or tmax_c < 0 on 2025-01-20, while baseline Mondays had milder conditions.
hypotheses.refute_if: Weather on 2025-01-20 was similar to or better than baseline Mondays (no snow, low precipitation, comparable temperatures).

hypotheses.statement: The fare mix shifted on 2025-01-20 toward higher-fare trip types (e.g., longer distances, airport trips, tolls) compared to baseline Mondays.
hypotheses.support_if: avg_trip_distance on 2025-01-20 is significantly higher than baseline Mondays, and/or trip count distribution by distance bands (if available) shows more long trips.
hypotheses.refute_if: avg_trip_distance on 2025-01-20 is similar to or lower than baseline Mondays.

hypotheses.statement: Pickup/drop-off zone mix shifted on 2025-01-20 (e.g., more airport/Manhattan core trips) increasing average fare, but daily aggregates lack zone detail so this is a proxy via distance/fare correlation.
hypotheses.support_if: avg_trip_distance and avg_total_amount both spike together on 2025-01-20, suggesting longer/higher-fare zones; zone-level data would confirm but not available in daily aggregate.
hypotheses.refute_if: avg_trip_distance does not increase with avg_total_amount, weakening zone-mix explanation.

hypotheses.statement: Data quality issue on 2025-01-20 (e.g., missing trips, duplicate records, fare calculation errors) artificially inflated avg_total_amount.
hypotheses.support_if: Trip count on 2025-01-20 is anomalously low/high vs baseline Mondays, or avg_total_amount is an extreme outlier (>3 std dev from baseline mean).
hypotheses.refute_if: Trip count and avg_total_amount on 2025-01-20 are within normal ranges of baseline Mondays; no obvious data anomalies.
